description: Header file defining a template class CountingAllocator for custom memory allocation tracking, used within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: CountingAllocator
classes.description: A stateful allocator that tracks memory usage and instance count, with rebind capability.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for n objects of type T, updating bytes used.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory for n objects, updating bytes used.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs an object of type U at a given memory location, increments instance count.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys an object of type U at a given memory location, decrements instance count.
